BiblicalUsage: Kelal, Chelal, is an Israelite named among those who had taken foreign wives in Ezra's day. Ezra 10:30 lists him with the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chelal's name is kept because the reckoning was real: every man who had married outside the covenant was named, and the people put the wives away.
